Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 411)

This update covers builds 366 to 411.

Work Board (new)

  • A Trello-style board of lists and cards for your workspaces. Cards follow your agent sessions, tabs, pull requests, links and files.
  • Cards show the agent's model, context and cost, a working bar while the agent (or its subagents) works, and a short "From session" summary.
  • Board AI: a chat panel that reads the board, asks your sessions for status, starts sessions and moves cards. It has an optional local memory you can edit.
  • Smooth card drag: one card flies into its place; near the Trash it crumples into a paper ball. Lists and the Board scroll at the edges.
  • Card window: description, private notes, checklist, links and files, a resizable side panel; a click outside closes it.

Mini Player

  • A floating music Mini Player with themes, system volume, sliding covers, and it comes back after relaunch.

Browser

  • Browser profiles with icons, a right-click menu and a new-tab page; a simpler browser bar.

Look

  • Nostalgia theme: a paint-only retro look for the top bar, tabs, toolbar and group chips.

Fixes

  • Quieter restarts, quiet waiting dots, recent icons, one tab per page, and many smaller fixes.
